# Stacking point values

Used in [Stacking, zones of control and reserve](/rules/50-stacking-and-zoc).

## Table

| Equivalent | SP | Shell of |
|---|---|---|
| division | 5 | none |
| super brigade | 3 | division |
| brigade | 2 | none |
| battalion | 1 | brigade, battle group |
| company | 0 | battalion, hq with attachments |

## Per five points

- **Truck-convoy:** 0.5
- **Replacement-points:** 1

## Notes

- SP per unit equivalent when at full strength, and which formations drop to that value as shells (SPI 9.26-9.28, restated in rules/50-stacking-and-zoc.md): a shell division counts as a super brigade, a shell brigade or battle group as a battalion, a shell battalion or an HQ with anything attached as a company
- Truck points in convoy count half an SP per five points or fraction (only for whether the road/track CP rate applies); replacement points one SP per five or fraction
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 96) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p2): 0 of 9 cells differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
